risk_flags.description: The contract assumes the pricing page is the markdown file docs/pricing.md. If the actual public pricing page is generated elsewhere, this would satisfy the contract while failing the request.
risk_flags.span: docs/pricing.md table row for Free plan reads 'up to 200' in the Expenses per month column

risk_flags.description: The contract excludes source and test changes based on an implementation assertion made before work begins. If the free-plan limit is enforced or validated in code, the visible pricing update could become inaccurate.
risk_flags.span: No changes to Python source code — the 100-expense limit is a hosted-backup policy documented in docs only, not enforced in tally/

verdict.primary_risk: The contract may only update documentation while missing the actual pricing page or any code-backed enforcement of the new limit.
